note: Reference schema for manual Airtable base setup. See airtable/fields.md for step-by-step creation instructions. Fields marked "Phase 2+" are stored/reserved but not yet driving pipeline behavior beyond what's noted.

fields.name: Channel
fields.notes: Phase 2+ (multi-channel support not implemented yet)

fields.name: Status
fields.notes: 'Topic Review' only appears on rows created by the discovery engine (TOPIC_MODE=discovery) -- see Topic Approved below.

fields.name: Target Runtime
fields.notes: target runtime in minutes

fields.name: Target Word Count
fields.notes: optional; derived from Target Runtime if blank

fields.name: Narration Style
fields.notes: Phase 2+ (not yet fed into prompt/voice tuning)

fields.name: Narration Speed
fields.notes: Phase 2+ (not yet applied to TTS)

fields.name: Average Scene Duration
fields.notes: seconds; overrides Scene Density's default if set

fields.name: Map Usage
fields.notes: routes to image fallback -- no dedicated map component yet

fields.name: Chart Usage
fields.notes: routes to image fallback -- no dedicated chart component yet

fields.name: AI Image Usage
fields.notes: opt-in only -- Higgsfield-generated image used as a fallback when Pexels/Pixabay search misses, requires HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY_ID + HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY_SECRET

fields.name: AI Video Usage
fields.notes: opt-in only -- Higgsfield-generated video used as a fallback when Pexels/Pixabay search misses, requires HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY_ID + HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY_SECRET

fields.name: Background Music
fields.notes: Phase 2+ (not implemented yet)

fields.name: Caption Style
fields.notes: Phase 2+ (captions not yet rendered)

fields.name: Research Depth
fields.notes: Phase 3 (research agent not implemented yet)

fields.name: Script
fields.notes: human-readable narration, filled in when Status becomes Script Review

fields.name: Script JSON
fields.notes: machine-readable Script object; read back by the orchestrator once Script Approved is checked

fields.name: Auto Publish
fields.notes: Phase 2+ (upload always runs today once Final Video Approved is checked)

fields.name: Auto Repurpose
fields.notes: Phase 2+ (repurposing not implemented yet)

fields.name: Publish Date
fields.notes: Phase 2+ (scheduling not implemented yet -- upload happens immediately on approval)

fields.name: Priority
fields.notes: Phase 2+ (not yet used to order the job queue)

fields.name: Topic Approved
fields.notes: discovery engine only (TOPIC_MODE=discovery) -- checking this on a 'Topic Review' row flips Status to Start, handing off to B1 exactly like a manually-entered title

fields.name: Opportunity Score
fields.notes: 0-100, set by the discovery engine -- see services/discovery/score.ts

fields.name: Opportunity Rationale
fields.notes: plain-language explanation of the score (YouTube velocity, Reddit engagement, Trends), set by the discovery engine

fields.name: Opportunity Sources
fields.notes: newline-separated source URLs (YouTube video, Reddit post) the discovery engine used as evidence

tables.name: Media Assets
tables.notes: Source/copyright ledger -- one row per downloaded stock/archival asset (Update 7).

tables.name: Shorts
tables.notes: One row per repurposed vertical clip cut from a Published video, posted cross-platform via Blotato (opt-in, Update 12).

fields.name: Hook
fields.notes: opening line used for the clip, pulled from its first scene

fields.name: Segment
fields.notes: scene id range this clip was cut from, e.g. scene-03..scene-05
